headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 30, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Junior Perez leading the offense and Erick Fedde earning the win. The Texas Rangers took down the Cleveland Guardians 4-2, thanks to Jacob deGrom's 7.0 innings of work and Joc Pederson's home run and 2 RBI. The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-0, with Cristopher Sánchez pitching 7.0 innings and striking out 9 batters.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Matt Chapman (abdominal strain) and Kris Bubic (left elbow soreness), who have both been placed on the injured list by their respective teams. Corey Seager (lower back inflammation) and Will Vest (right posterior elbow inflammation) have also been placed on the injured list.

The MLB trade market has been active, with several notable transactions taking place. The Athletics traded 3B Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for RHP Ben Hansen, while the Texas Rangers traded C Ben Hartl to the Chicago White Sox for RHP Ben Peoples. The San Francisco Giants traded 1B Buddy Kennedy to the Seattle Mariners for cash, and the Toronto Blue Jays traded RHP Hayden Juenger to the Athletics for C Owen Carapellotti.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Orioles 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Junior Perez leading the offense with a home run and three RBIs. Erick Fedde earned the win for the White Sox, while Tyler Schweitzer earned the save.

top_news.title: **Rangers Take Down Guardians 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a 4-2 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jacob deGrom earning the win after 7.0 innings of work. Joc Pederson led the Rangers' offense with a home run and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Suffer Shutout Loss to Phillies**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates, winning 8-0. Cristopher Sánchez led the way for the Phillies, pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Yankees 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a convincing 9-3 victory over the New York Yankees, with Riley Greene leading the offense. Tarik Skubal earned the win with 6 strong innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **White Sox Fall to Orioles in Dominant 6-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox suffered a one-sided defeat, losing 6-1 to the Baltimore Orioles. Noah Schultz was the lone bright spot for the White Sox, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Orioles' strong performance.

top_news.title: **Rangers Fall to Guardians in 9-4 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 9-4 victory over the Texas Rangers, snapping their opponent's winning streak. MacKenzie Gore led the Guardians' pitching effort, while Ezequiel Duran and Elias Díaz contributed to the Rangers' offense.

top_news.title: **Giants Place Chapman on Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants third baseman Matt Chapman has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to an abdominal strain.

top_news.title: **Athletics Acquire RHP Ben Hansen in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring right-handed pitcher Ben Hansen from the Boston Red Sox in exchange for third baseman Brett Harris.
